annotations.title: Compare 2–4 places in Spain on local data

description: Side-by-side latest figures for 2–4 municipalities (provinces of Alicante, Málaga, Valencia, Murcia) or buyer zones: housing prices (MIVAU), rent (SERPAVI), IBI, population, income, tourist lets, foreigners, air quality and more — at most 12 indicators per call. Each figure has its unit, period, level (municipality, or province when the place has none), source credit and date, and station or point of interest with distance. Only places whose flatin.es page is published get figures; every answer links the flatin.es pages.

indicators.description: Up to 12 indicator keys; default: mivau_valor_tasado_total, rent_m2_median, ibi, padron29005, income_person, vt_viviendas, vt_pct, foreign_total, share_65plus, aq_no2_annual, aq_pm25_annual, tourist_occ_pct. Keys whose source terms do not allow export answer 'not_available' (the value is on the page).

locale.description: Language of names and page links; default en.

places.description: 2 to 4 places: a municipality of the provinces of Alicante, Málaga, Valencia or Murcia (name, slug, 'province/municipality' or 5-digit INE code) or a buyer zone (costa-blanca, costa-del-sol); prefix 'municipio:' / 'zona:' to disambiguate.
